baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 2, 5, and 6: the commission, its human destination, and the stay within that collective.
baseline_models.mechanism: The act of sending establishes a communicative office, but the following locative stay prevents the office from reading as a brief delivery. The messenger remains embedded in the same social body to which he was directed.

activation_trace.role: The messenger-and-message sense makes the initial sending an entrusted communicative office.
The human-collective sense identifies a durable social body rather than an accidental audience.
Locative persistence turns the commission into sustained co-presence among that body.

changed_reading.before: Noah was sent to his people and happened to remain there for a long time.
changed_reading.after: The sending opens an embedded mission whose defining action is sustained presence inside the addressed collective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 8, 9, 11, and 12: a thousand, the first year-term, the fifty-unit exception, and the second year-term.
baseline_models.mechanism: The duration is composed rather than rounded: an aggregate thousand is explicitly reduced by fifty. The switch between two year lexemes retains both a plain calendrical measure and a secondary sense of recurring temporal course, so the span is exact without being texturally flat.

activation_trace.role: The aggregated-thousand sense supplies the large counted total.
The direct year-and-term sense supplies the first calendrical unit.
The alternate mapped sense of a followed course keeps recurring passage faintly active beside the literal year.
The five-based numeral sense supplies the fifty-unit subtraction.
The complete-year cycle supplies the second temporal unit and closes the calculation.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives a rounded way of saying that the mission lasted about 950 years.
changed_reading.after: The verse deliberately builds 950 as a thousand less fifty and marks the subtraction with a change of year-word, foregrounding reckoned duration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 13, 14, and 16: the taking, the flood, and the collective's concurrent condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: The flood is grammatically the taker, and its branch inventory supplies an event that surrounds what it reaches. The closing condition links that spatial capture to active misplacement and withholding of what is due, making the seizure accountable rather than merely meteorological.

activation_trace.role: The grasp-and-possession sense gives the flood the functional role of captor.
The accountability sense makes the taking answer to conduct rather than chance.
The all-around inundation sense supplies the spatial mechanism of capture.
Material misplacement supplies a concrete model for a condition out of proper order.
Withholding what is due supplies the accountable social axis of that condition.

changed_reading.before: A flood killed a population already labeled wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: An enveloping event takes the collective while wrongful displacement and withholding are their live condition, binding spatial capture to accountability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence treats communal claims as material exposed to assay until truth and falsity become manifest. Against that frame, the extraordinary stay within Noah's collective becomes the duration of disclosure: persistence gives the people's orientation time to harden into an observable condition.

activation_trace.role: Sustained residence supplies the temporal chamber in which the collective remains exposed.
The assay sense frames not being left alone as being tested for what one actually is.
Repeated assay extends that process backward across earlier communities and toward Noah's people.
Disclosure to a knower makes differentiation the functional result of testing.
Truth realized in action supplies one disclosed outcome rather than a verbal claim alone.
Contradiction of truth supplies the opposite disclosed outcome.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 opens with the sequence claim, testing, and manifested differentiation before the Noah account.
The focus closes with a circumstantial description of the people, presenting their condition at seizure as the result visible after the long stay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay-and-disclosure language plus extraordinary co-residence; I infer that duration functions as the medium through which communal allegiance becomes manifest. A live alternative is that the number only magnifies the messenger's endurance.

changed_reading.before: The long stay measures how patiently Noah continued an unsuccessful mission.
changed_reading.after: The long stay is also an extended communal assay: time exposes what the people become while the messenger remains among them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus places an immense slow interval directly before a taking. Elsewhere the surah names an appointed limit, rebukes attempts to accelerate punishment, and says its arrival can be sudden. Patience holds through the open interval; closure need not resemble the pace of the waiting that precedes it.

activation_trace.role: Delay and slowness supply the prolonged open interval.
The grasping sense supplies decisive closure immediately after the counted span.
A fixed temporal limit makes deferred arrival scheduled rather than absent.
Demanded acceleration supplies the human pressure to collapse the interval.
The named limit blocks haste while preserving certainty of closure.
Abrupt arrival supplies the sharp temporal edge after delay.
Self-restraint under distress supplies the posture appropriate to the long interval.

structural_cues: 29:53 places demanded haste, an appointed limit, and sudden arrival in one sequence.
In the focus, the counted residence is followed by a prefixed sequential transition into the taking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies long delay, fixed term, haste, and abrupt arrival; I infer one temporal mechanism of respite followed by non-gradual closure. The alternative is simple chronology with no deliberate contrast of temporal rates.

changed_reading.before: A 950-year mission ended when a flood later occurred.
changed_reading.after: The 950-year respite and the decisive taking form one temporal pattern: an appointed interval can be extremely long while its closure remains sudden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah opposes the plural collective taken in the focus to Noah and the ship-company extracted from danger. A vessel that cuts the water creates a traversable boundary inside an otherwise surrounding event, and the preserved vessel or episode remains an outward marker.

activation_trace.role: All-around inundation supplies the undifferentiated danger field.
Collective capture supplies one side of the separation.
Escape by separation supplies the operative logic of rescue.
A vessel cutting the water supplies the material boundary that permits passage through enclosure.
The visible-marker sense turns the preserved vessel or event into evidence beyond its immediate survivors.

structural_cues: 29:14 ends with a plural group taken; 29:15 begins by separating Noah and the vessel's companions for rescue.
The rescue object is then made a marker for wider communities, so survival has an evidentiary afterlife.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surrounding capture, extraction, a water-cutting vessel, and a visible marker; I infer the flood functions as a selective boundary rather than indiscriminate water. The alternative is that rescue and destruction are adjacent outcomes without a shared spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The flood is chiefly the instrument that destroys Noah's people.
changed_reading.after: The flood is a boundary event: it captures one collective while a separated vessel-company crosses the same enclosure and becomes its enduring sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later statement restricts the messenger's obligation to making the message arrive clearly. Read back into the focus, long residence is not evidence that the commission failed because the collective did not change; it is evidence that delivery was sustained while conversion and final taking remained outside the messenger's office.

activation_trace.role: The entrusted messenger role anchors the focus in communicative office.
Long co-residence makes fulfillment of that office durative rather than momentary.
The recurring messenger role generalizes the office beyond the Noah account.
Causing the message to reach its addressees supplies the stated measure of duty.
Clarification by speech or sign qualifies delivery as manifest rather than merely attempted.

structural_cues: 29:18 follows the Noah episode closely and formulates the messenger's obligation as a limit.
The focus assigns the long stay to Noah but assigns the final taking to the flood, keeping mission and outcome under different agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a long commission and an explicit role restriction; I infer that mission fidelity is measured by sustained clear delivery rather than recipient conversion. The alternative is that 29:18 states a general rule without retrospectively evaluating Noah's duration.

changed_reading.before: The extreme duration highlights how long Noah failed to persuade his people.
changed_reading.after: The extreme duration displays sustained fulfillment of a bounded messenger duty; the people's response and the flood's taking are not measures of failed delivery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's later disaster inventory repeats taking, indexes each taking to its own fault, includes drowning among several modalities, denies wrongdoing by God, and reflexively returns wrongdoing to the sufferers themselves. This expands the focus's closing condition into a causal and legal safeguard around the flood.

activation_trace.role: Accountable taking anchors the focus event in response to conduct.
Withholding from what is due supplies the focus condition that makes taking answerable rather than arbitrary.
Repeated accountable taking places the Noah event inside a wider rule of requital.
Personal fault supplies the explicit index linking each group to its outcome.
Death by submersion identifies the focus flood as one modality within the indexed series.
The repeated rights-withholding sense supports the denial that the judging agent commits the wrong.
The self-or-very-entity sense makes the final attribution reflexive: the wrong returns to its own agents.

structural_cues: 29:40 uses a distributive opening, then assigns distinct disasters to different groups under one fault-indexed rule.
Its final contrast explicitly denies wrong by God and locates wrong in the sufferers' own selves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distributive taking by fault, drowning, and reflexive wrongdoing; I infer that the focus's concurrent wrongdoing clause is causal-legal framing, not an incidental epithet. The alternative is that 29:40 summarizes separate histories without specifying the syntax of 29:14.

changed_reading.before: The people are called wrongdoers to justify a flood already narrated.
changed_reading.after: Their active wrongdoing is the event's allocation rule: the flood is one self-indexed mode of taking, while the text explicitly excludes arbitrary wrong by the judging agent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The flood's branch inventory already makes it surrounding. Later punishment is described first as already enclosing and then as covering its objects from above and below. These echoes convert the flood from a merely large volume of water into one local instance of consequence becoming spatially inescapable.

activation_trace.role: Surrounding inundation anchors the focus in total spatial exposure.
Enclosure by overpowering ruin generalizes the focus topology beyond water.
A covering that spreads over all supplies the vertical face of inescapability.
The alternate mapped covering sense reinforces concealment beneath what descends.

structural_cues: 29:54 says the consequence is already enclosing even while it is being demanded.
29:55 completes the geometry with coverage from above and below.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three convergent spatial images: surrounding flood, enclosing consequence, and covering from both vertical directions. I infer a recurring topology of inescapability; the live alternative is independent imagery with no intended backward activation.

changed_reading.before: The flood matters because it is an exceptionally destructive quantity of water.
changed_reading.after: The flood matters as a topology of consequence: the people's condition becomes an enclosure with no exterior available to them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the surah's end, boarding a vessel amid danger produces exclusive calling, rescue to land, and immediate return to association. That sequence miniaturizes the Noah pattern and adds a diagnostic distinction: crisis can separate and rescue bodies without producing durable inward reorientation.

activation_trace.role: The encompassing flood anchors the original sea-crisis pattern.
Mounting a conveyance initiates a repeatable embodied crisis scene.
The waterborne vessel reproduces the material setting of traversing danger.
Urgent address supplies the verbal response elicited by enclosure.
Exclusive allegiance supplies a temporary purification from competing attachments.
Escape by separation repeats the rescue logic immediately following the focus.
Restored association after landing shows that physical rescue need not become durable allegiance.

structural_cues: 29:65 orders vessel, exclusive call, rescue, landfall, and relapse as a compact cycle.
29:14-15 orders encompassing danger, taking, vessel rescue, and sign, providing the larger historical pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two vessel-and-rescue sequences; I infer that the later one replays the focus as an assay of allegiance and exposes the instability of crisis-born sincerity. The alternative is a generic sea-danger example with no specific Noahic reprise.

changed_reading.before: Noah's flood is a remote historical division between destroyed wrongdoers and saved companions.
changed_reading.after: The flood also becomes a recurring diagnostic pattern: enclosure may elicit exclusive appeal and permit rescue, yet rescue alone does not secure lasting reform.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the adjacent moral burden vocabulary as load-bearing imagery around the flood and vessel. It remains anchored in the focus taking and surrounding event and in the immediately following ship; downstream prose should present it as a sequence-level material analogy, not as the lexical definition of the focus words.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 13-14, the taking by an enclosing event, read between the preceding burden claims and the following vessel.

activation_trace.role: Capture supplies the focus-side limit on who or what is transferred.
The surrounding water supplies the material field in which carrying becomes concrete.
Assuming another's moral load supplies the false transfer claim immediately before the focus.
Actual bearing of liability reverses the promised transfer and restores ownership of the load.
Load made heavy turns liability into material pressure at the narrative threshold.
The water-cutting vessel supplies the literal carrier that follows the moral carrying dispute.

changed_reading.before: The burden verses, Noah's flood, and the ship are adjacent but independent topics.
changed_reading.after: The sequence tests transfer itself: false agents promise to carry liability, actual agents bear their own heavy loads, the flood takes a collective, and a real vessel carries only a separated rescued company.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the thousand is plainly a numeral, not a direct statement of affection or familiarity. It remains anchored in that exact focus root, the stay among a people, and the surah's later account of mutual attachment; downstream prose should call it a root-image echo rather than an alternative translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 5, 6, and 8: the people, prolonged residence among them, and the thousand-root.

activation_trace.role: The secondary familiarity-and-habituation sense lets the counted span also suggest accumulated social familiarity.
The human collective supplies the social body within which familiarity could accumulate.
Residence among the group supplies the sustained contact required for habituation.
Mutual affection supplies a later model of social glue that can consolidate around false objects.
A bond maintained between parties supplies the relational structure of that glue.

changed_reading.before: The thousand contributes only numerical magnitude to the stay.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root echo, the thousand also intimates accumulated familiarity: centuries of co-presence need not loosen a collective when its mutual bonds consolidate around the wrong center.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it compares the focus flood with ordinary descending water much later in the surah. It remains anchored in the flood's water-enclosure and the packet's explicit water-to-life mechanism; downstream prose should preserve the contrast without turning the historical flood into a free allegory.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 14, the encompassing flood, reconsidered against the surah's later life-giving water.

activation_trace.role: Overwhelming surrounding water supplies the destructive face of the medium.
Plain water supplies the shared material medium for the comparison.
Earth revived through rain supplies the medium's constructive causal direction.
Loss of life or force supplies the state that the same medium reverses in the later scene.

changed_reading.before: Water in the focus is inherently an image of destruction.
changed_reading.after: Water has double agency across the surah: as enclosing flood it takes a collective fixed in wrongdoing, while as measured descent it restores life to dead earth; relation and mode, not substance alone, determine its effect.

strongest_changes: The 950-year residence became an extended assay and sustained fulfillment of a bounded messenger office, not merely a measure of failed persuasion.
The immense delay and abrupt taking became one appointed-term mechanism: respite can be long while closure remains sudden.
The flood became a selective, self-indexed boundary that captures one collective while a vessel-company is separated for rescue and evidence.
The later sea-crisis cycle reactivated the Noah event as a recurring test in which rescue does not guarantee durable reorientation.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah cues repeatedly reactivated the focus through temporal control, enclosure, accountable taking, transport, rescue, and relapse. The split time-root inventories also preserved secondary textures without forcing them into the literal arithmetic.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the switch between the two year lexemes carries deliberate temporal texture beyond exact counting.
Whether the later enclosure and above-below coverage deliberately recall the flood or simply reuse independent consequence imagery.
Whether the burden-to-vessel sequence is a designed load-bearing analogy or only suggestive adjacency.
How much interpretive weight the numeral-root's familiarity branch can bear beyond a carefully marked lexical echo.
